name: Flatland Prowler Claw
summary: Across Mulgore's plains, Flatland Prowler Claws mark a young hunter's trial. Hunters gather them to prove their resolve and fieldcraft to the elders of Thunder Bluff.

sections.title: A Hunter's Proof
sections.body: Flatland prowlers stalk Mulgore's plains, quick to ambush prey in tall grass. Their cunning and territorial nature makes them dangerous to travelers and a hard test for young hunters. Gathering their claws is a recognized tradition. Skorn Whitecloud sends promising wanderers to bring the claws to Melor Stonehoof at Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff, proof that they have the resolve and fieldcraft to follow the hunter's way.

faq.q: What are Flatland Prowler Claws used for?
faq.answer: Young hunters bring four Flatland Prowler Claws to Melor Stonehoof at Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. The claws prove their skill and courage, and their readiness to follow the hunter's path.

faq.q: Who asks you to collect them?
faq.answer: Skorn Whitecloud asks promising trackers to gather claws from Mulgore's prowlers before presenting themselves to Melor Stonehoof.

faq.q: Why are flatland prowlers considered a fitting hunt?
faq.answer: Flatland prowlers are tough, stealthy carnivores native to Mulgore's plains. Tracking and defeating these alert predators tests the patience and combat instincts tauren tradition asks of a hunter.

angles.text: As a tauren, you honor the hunt as a spiritual tradition. Presenting the claws of a cunning plains predator marks your first steps toward serving your tribe as a tracker.
As a hunter, you test your field awareness against stealthy prowlers. Their claws mark earned respect among the marksmen at Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff.
